params.name: status
params.description: Filter by item status. Comma-separated for multiple values.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order. `updated` sorts by last-updated timestamp (default, best for sync). `library_position` sorts by the item's manual queue ordering (queue_order). `inbox_position` sorts by the item's feed position (newest first). Neither position ordering requires a status filter — items without a position sort last (nulls last).

params.name: tag
params.description: Filter to items with a specific tag ID. Comma-separated for multiple (matches **any**).

params.name: content_type
params.description: Filter by content type. Comma-separated for multiple.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Return only items updated after this time. Useful for incremental sync.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results per page. Min 1, max 100.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor for the next page of results, from a previous `next_cursor`.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of items in your library.

Save a new item to your library by URL. Triggers background content
extraction. Check `processing_status` to know when the item is ready.

About 40% of saves complete instantly (cached content). For the rest,
processing typically takes 20–60 seconds.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of additional fields. Currently supported: `markdown`. Markdown requests count against the content rate limit (20/min).

items.docs: Returns a single item from your library with full metadata.
Update an item's status, favorite state, or reading progress.
Permanently remove an item from your library.
